MKTG6018.name: Customer Analytics and Relationship Management
MKTG6018.summary_en: This unit combines customer relationship management with practical customer analytics. Students learn to understand customer relationships, analyse customer databases, improve customer profitability and communicate insights through data visualisation; no prior statistics knowledge is required.
MKTG6018.summary_zh: 这门课把客户关系管理（CRM）与实际 Customer Analytics 结合起来，学习理解客户关系、分析客户数据库、提升客户价值，并通过数据可视化传达洞察；不要求先修统计知识。
MKTG6018.learning_path_zh: 客户中心战略 → Customer Segmentation → CLV 与客户指标 → CRM Strategy → Text Analytics / NLP → Statistical Learning
MKTG6018.learning_path_en: Customer-centric strategy → segmentation → CLV and customer metrics → CRM strategy → text analytics / NLP → statistical learning
MKTG6018.source_note_zh: 来源：MKTG6018 Semester 2 2026 Unit Outline 与 Canvas。Canvas 当前发布 Week 1–3 的详细资料；未发布周次仅展示 Unit Outline 主题。

MKTG6104.name: Psychology of Marketing Decisions
MKTG6104.summary_en: This unit examines how heuristics and psychological biases shape business and consumer decisions. Students compare real human decision behaviour with logical decision rules and learn strategies for recognising and counteracting systematic errors.
MKTG6104.summary_zh: 这门课研究启发式判断和心理偏差如何影响商业与消费者决策，把真实的人类决策行为与逻辑最优规则进行比较，并学习识别和应对系统性决策错误。
MKTG6104.learning_path_zh: 决策模型 → 偏差与陷阱 → Heuristics → Framing → 动机、情绪与群体影响 → 公平与伦理
MKTG6104.learning_path_en: Decision models → biases and traps → heuristics → framing → motivational, emotional and group influences → fairness and ethics
MKTG6104.source_note_zh: 来源：MKTG6104 Semester 2 2026 Canvas。2026 官方 Unit Outline 当前显示未发布；Assessment、Week 1–13 与课前任务均按 Canvas 原文整理。
MKTG6104.source_note_en: Source: MKTG6104 Semester 2 2026 Canvas. The public 2026 Unit Outline is currently unavailable; assessments, Weeks 1–13 and preparation tasks are taken from Canvas.

SIEN6006.name: Entrepreneurship
SIEN6006.summary_en: This unit builds foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and innovation across individual, organisational and ecosystem levels, including sustainable, technology, medical, social and cultural entrepreneurship.
SIEN6006.summary_zh: 这门课建立创业与创新的基础知识，从个人、组织和生态系统层面理解创业过程，并涵盖可持续、科技、医疗、社会与文化创业等情境。
SIEN6006.learning_path_zh: 创业基础 → 创业与创新过程 → 个人、组织与生态系统 → 可持续 / 科技 / 医疗 / 社会文化创业 → Storytelling 与反思
SIEN6006.learning_path_en: Entrepreneurship foundations → entrepreneurial and innovation processes → individuals, organisations and ecosystems → contextual entrepreneurship → storytelling and reflection
SIEN6006.source_note_zh: 来源：SIEN6006 Semester 2 2026 Unit Outline 与 Canvas。Canvas 当前可见 Week 1–6 与 Week 13 资源；其他周次按 Unit Outline 展示，不推测未发布的课前任务。
SIEN6006.source_note_en: Sources: SIEN6006 Semester 2 2026 Unit Outline and Canvas. Canvas currently exposes resources for Weeks 1–6 and Week 13; other weeks use the Unit Outline without inferred preparation tasks.
